title: Event-Driven Pub/Sub & Stream Processing
learningObjectives: Design event schemas with backward and forward compatibility
Differentiate point-to-point queues from broadcast publish/subscribe models
Manage consumer groups, partition offsets, and message ordering semantics
keyTradeoffs: Partition-key ordering guarantees vs total throughput parallelism
Event sourcing full state derivation vs lightweight change data capture (CDC)
commonPitfalls: Publishing events before the database transaction has successfully committed (dual-write hazard)
Consumers failing to handle out-of-order event delivery
transferPrompt: How does a pub/sub cluster fan out messages across distributed WebSocket gateway nodes?
